## Summary

In the gallery image sheet, the date should not be required, and it should use the same **partial date picker** used elsewhere in the app (which supports year-only / month-year / unknown dates) rather than the full calendar `DatePicker`.

## Motivation

Historical photos often have an unknown or only approximately-known date (year only, decade, etc.). The image sheet currently forces a concrete `Date`:

```tsx
// frontend/src/components/view/gallery-view/ImageSheet.tsx
<DatePicker
  value={new Date(formData.createdAt || new Date())}   // ← always defaults to "now"
  onChange={canWrite ? handleDateChange : undefined}
/>
```

This means every image ends up with a full date (defaulting to today), and you can't express "sometime in 1950" — unlike member birth/death dates which use `PartialDatePicker`.

## Proposed approach

- Replace the gallery `DatePicker` with `PartialDatePicker` (`frontend/src/components/ui/partial-date-picker.tsx`), and allow it to be empty/cleared.
- Separate "photo date" from the row's `createdAt` if `createdAt` is also used as an upload timestamp — an empty photo date must be allowed without breaking sorting/`ImageCard` display (see the miniatures date rendering).
- Update the backend schema/model so the gallery date is nullable and accepts partial-date strings, with a migration.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Gallery image date can be left empty and saved
- [ ] Partial dates (year-only, month-year) are supported and displayed consistently with the rest of the app
- [ ] `ImageCard` and any date sorting handle a missing date gracefully
- [ ] Alembic migration if the model/column changes; i18n keys in all locales
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`

- `frontend/src/components/view/gallery-view/ImageCard.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/ui/partial-date-picker.tsx`

_EXIF_DATE_TAGS = (36867, 36868)  # DateTimeOriginal, DateTimeDigitized (Exif SubIFD)

_EXIF_YEAR_MIN = 1400
_EXIF_YEAR_MAX_SLACK = 1  # tolerate camera clocks a little ahead of the server

    """Best-effort EXIF date-taken lookup; returns ``None`` on any failure.

    coarser base ``DateTime`` tag, since that's what most cameras and phones
    write. Never raises — corrupt EXIF, an unsupported format, or a garbage
    timestamp must never break or slow down an upload.

                return None

                exif_ifd = exif.get_ifd(_EXIF_SUBIFD_TAG)

                    raw = exif_ifd.get(tag)
                    if raw:
                        break

                raw = None
            raw = raw or exif.get(_EXIF_BASE_DATE_TAG)
            if not isinstance(raw, str):
                return None

            match = _EXIF_DATE_RE.match(raw)
            if not match:
                return None
            year, month, day = match.groups()
            year_int, month_int, day_int = int(year), int(month), int(day)
            current_year = date.today().year
            if not (_EXIF_YEAR_MIN <= year_int <= current_year + _EXIF_YEAR_MAX_SLACK):
                return None
            if not (1 <= month_int <= 12) or not (1 <= day_int <= 31):
                return None
            return f"{year}-{month}-{day}"
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - EXIF extraction is best-effort only

def _jpeg_with_exif_date(date_taken: str | None) -> bytes:
    """A tiny JPEG, optionally carrying an EXIF DateTimeOriginal tag."""
    img = Image.new("RGB", (4, 4), "red")
    buffer = BytesIO()
    if date_taken is None:
        img.save(buffer, format="JPEG")
    else:
        exif = Image.Exif()
        exif.get_ifd(0x8769)[36867] = date_taken  # DateTimeOriginal
        img.save(buffer, format="JPEG", exif=exif.tobytes())
    return buffer.getvalue()
